test_button_mask_engine: the guard counts the ticks the ENGINE refuses the warp press while the hero stands, whatever the row says. From royalesim 0.1.17 the row's available is the engine's own verdict (Sim's button_verdict), so the old guard (row available while the engine waits) found nothing and called the test vacuous; the mask-vs-engine check every tick is unchanged and passes on 0.1.16 and 0.1.17 (found by Sim's ship44 gate)

button_index (observation row 23, Train 10-06): SpatialObsBuilder(button_index=True) appends own_button_cards [K x (n+1)] one-hot per button index (like own_hand_cards; n = no button) and own_button_{available,spent,cooldown}_by_index [K], after the card_status fields and before any reveal, K = the parser's buttons; refused without buttons or with rows that do not name the card. The card-keyed button fields could not say which card button k is, and a network learned it from deck order. Tested on RustEngine with two heroes dealt in both orders (button 0 follows the order) and on hand-made rows; nothing moves with it off; two plants caught

unit_aliases (Train's ruling 10-05): SpatialObsBuilder(unit_aliases=...) writes a row as its base type before the planes are built; obs.SAME_UNIT_ALIASES holds the 7 rows that are one unit to a player (Graveyard_rework_Skeleton, SkeletonKingSkeleton -> Skeleton; GoblinCurseGoblin -> Goblin; DeliveryRecruit -> Recruit; TriWizard -> Wizard; Ghost_EV1_Summon_Right -> _Left; ThreeMusketeer_Rework_Character_3 -> _1). The aliased names leave the vocabulary; config() records unit_aliases; builder.unit_ids_digest names the effective vocabulary. Refuses unknown names, chains and self-aliases. A test checks every shipped pair has identical stats in the engine's card table (green on Sim's ut-407f818 build; Goblin_Stab and SpearGoblin_Dummy differ and stay out). Corrects the docs: the Graveyard's skeletons keep their own row unless aliased. Two plants caught

The mask asks the engine about every ability button its row calls usable (GridActionParser._button_judge = engine.check_deploy), as it asks where a building lands: the Hero Mega Minion's warp is taken only available_after_ms after the hero appears and only with a pick (state.rs check_ability_button, AbilityNotReady), which the row's available column does not carry, so the mask offered presses the engine refused. Found by Train (rl2-c illegal_actions, ~1 in 52 000); a 500-battle repro of its env with the field decks found 10 ABILITY_NOT_READY, all the hero Mega Minion. Test against a real battle (mask_disagreements empty every tick from the hero's spawn until the press is taken), plant caught; the row-reading test now isolates the rows
